text: dsh-live-browser 是 DSH 的网页浏览器工具插件，面向 Web、桌面和 CLI profile。它通过 DSH 侧边栏内的浏览器面板，让 agent 与用户操作同一个页面。主要功能包括打开和导航网页、读取页面文本与可交互元素、点击和输入、等待页面变化、导出图表图像，以及管理浏览器标签。适合需要在 DSH 对话中查看网页、填写页面或让 agent 完成浏览器任务的用户。安装并启用后无需 API 密钥；截图和下载目录可按需配置。

dsh-live-browser lets DSH agents operate pages in the sidebar browser. It supports navigation, reading page text and elements, clicking, typing, waiting, chart image export, and tab management. Use it to inspect or interact with web pages during a DSH conversation. No API key is needed.
想让 DSH agent 帮我浏览网页并操作页面。
能不能在 DSH 里让 AI 点击网页按钮、填写表单？
我希望 agent 读出当前浏览器页面的正文内容。
让 DSH 自动打开侧边栏浏览器并加载指定网址。
我想从网页中提取可交互元素并按元素定位操作。
能把网页里的图表导出成图片文件吗？
I want my DSH agent to interact with the page open in its sidebar browser.
Can an assistant read visible web page text and fill in forms for me?
dsh-live-browser 的功能「网页导航」：在 DSH 侧边栏浏览器打开网址，并支持后退、前进和刷新。调用 browser_navigate 提供地址；没有打开页面时可自动创建标签并加载目标网页。
dsh-live-browser 的功能「读取页面」：browser_snapshot 返回带稳定 ref 的可交互元素快照，browser_read_text 则读取可见正文并可用 CSS 选择器限定范围。
dsh-live-browser 的功能「网页交互」：agent 可按快照 ref 或 CSS selector 点击元素、向输入框输入文本，并进行按键、选择和滚动等操作。用户可在侧边栏看到页面交互。
dsh-live-browser 的功能「导出页面图像」：调用 browser_screenshot 将页面中的图表或元素导出为 PNG，并写入配置的图片目录；目录未设置时使用默认存储位置。
dsh-live-browser 需要 DSH 侧边栏浏览器提供可注入的 webview；Web 版跨域 iframe 无法执行页面交互，插件会提示切换到桌面版 webview。

让 agent 操作 DSH 自带的那个浏览器 —— 就在 DSH 里，什么都不离开窗口。

中文 | [English](README.en.md)

DSH 自带的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-browser` 会在右侧栏渲染一个真正的
Electron `<webview>`，带地址栏、历史记录和独立的浏览器会话。但它只开放了导航能力：
agent 能打开页面，却点不了、输不进、读不到、滚不动。

这个插件在**不修改 DSH 任何文件**的前提下补上这一段：找到官方插件挂载的那些 guest，
往每个文档里注入一套操作接口，再给模型 25 个 `browser_*` 工具，操作的正是用户眼前那张页面。
顺带把标签页右键菜单补全：**关闭其他标签页 / 关闭全部标签页 / 关闭右侧所有标签页**。

dsh-live-browser README · 安装：需要 DSH 0.2.x 与 Node.js 20 以上。插件在 `package.json` 里声明了 DSH 组合包，安装时
DSH 会自动注册。
dsh-live-browser README · 从 GitHub 安装：```bash

dsh-live-browser README · Web / CLI profile：dsh plugin --profile web add github:c347087870/dsh-live-browser
```

桌面版的 profile 由 Electron 应用独占，请从界面安装：**插件 → 添加插件**，粘贴
`https://github.com/c347087870/dsh-live-browser`，然后重启 DSH。

dsh-live-browser README · 从 npm 安装：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-live-browser
```

包地址：https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-live-browser 。装 npm 包的好处是能出现在 DSH
的「插件中心」里，一键安装。

dsh-live-browser README · 确认装好了：```bash
node -e "const p=require('./node_modules/dsh-live-browser/package.json');console.log(p.version, p.dsh)"
```

`dsh.bundle.patch` 必须存在，`lib/index.js` 必须存在。重启后日志里会出现
`[dsh-live-browser] loaded: 25 tools, driving the DSH sidebar browser`。

> 本地开发**不要**用 junction（`mklink /J`、`ln -s`）：Node 会解析真实路径，于是
> `schemastery` 去源码目录找而不是去 profile 找。要么复制整个包目录，要么用
> `dsh plugin` 安装。

dsh-live-browser README · 配置项：| 配置 | 默认 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `confirmSensitive` | `true` | 标记为 `sensitive` 的动作执行前先问用户 |
| `allowEval` | `true` | 是否允许 `browser_eval` 在页面里执行任意 JavaScript |
| `autoOpenPanel` | `true` | 命令到达但没有页面时，自动打开侧边栏浏览器 |
| `commandTimeoutMs` | `30000` | 单次命令等待面板执行的超时（毫秒） |
| `openPanelWaitMs` | `8000` | 打开面板后等待其就绪的时间 |
| `maxSnapshotNodes` | `400` | `browser_snapshot` 默认节点上限 |
| `maxTextChars` | `12000` | `browser_read_text` 默认字符上限 |
| `waitTimeoutMs` | `10000` | `browser_wait` 默认超时（毫秒） |
| `uploadMaxBytes` | `16777216` | `browser_upload` 单个文件的上限 |
| `imageDir` | 空 | `browser_screenshot` 的图片目录；留空用 `~/.dsh/storages/dsh-live-browser/images` |
| `downloadsDir` | 空 | `browser_downloads` 读取的目录；留空用系统「下载」文件夹 |

dsh-live-browser README · 配置项：想让 agent 只读页面、不在页面里跑代码，就把 `allowEval` 关掉。`browser_eval` 随后
返回 `executed: false`，并提示改用 `browser_snapshot` / `browser_read_text`。

dsh-live-browser README · 浏览器会自己打开：agent 不会先让你去开浏览器，也永远不会去开外部窗口：

- 工具把命令排进宿主队列，并标记它来自**哪个对话**。
- 插件的客户端 bundle 一直在轮询，即使当前一个浏览器标签页都没有。
- 命令到达时如果没有页面，客户端会自己调用侧边栏的
  `openTabIn(sessionId, 'browser', …)` 打开浏览器标签页，等 guest 挂载好再执行。

所以冷启动时一句 `browser_navigate`，表现就是右侧栏自己弹出一个标签页并加载目标地址。

dsh-live-browser README · 每个对话一个浏览器 worker：- 每个存活的 Session 都有自己独立的 `panelId` 和长轮询，并固定绑定自己的 Session id。
- 每条命令都带着发起它的 Session id（宿主侧取 `exec.agent.session.id`）；即使当前屏幕切到
  别的对话，后台对话的 worker 仍继续轮询，命令仍在它自己的 webview 里执行。
- 面板只在该 Session 自己的 `[data-sidebar-right-session]` 里找页面，不会操到当前显示的
  对话；后台对话的侧边栏即使被标了 `hidden` 也不影响执行。
- 需要打开浏览器时，用 `openTabIn(sessionId, …)` 在**发起请求的那个对话**里打开，
  而不是在屏幕上恰好显示的那个对话里。
- 同一 Session 有多个标签时，挑真正有布局盒子的那个，而不是最后挂载的那个。
- Web 版的 iframe 浏览器与 DSH 跨域，插件无法注入脚本：`browser_status` 会返回
  `mode: "iframe"` 并给出提示，右下角也会指导用户改用桌面版 webview。
section: 每个对话一个浏览器 worker

text:
dsh-live-browser README · 每个对话一个浏览器 worker：这消除了老的故障模式：在 A 对话要页面，没等它出来就切到 B，结果命令被拒绝或浏览器出现在 B。

> 为什么打开动作放在渲染层：侧边栏整个在客户端，它的宿主模块什么都不贡献，所以没有
> 宿主服务可调。客户端那一半通过 `ctx.reflect.provide` 发布 `sidebarRight`，插件用的就是这个。
section: 每个对话一个浏览器 worker

text:
dsh-live-browser README · 为什么用这个形态：| | 本插件 | 直接改官方 bundle |
|---|---|---|
| 点击 / 输入 / 读取 / 滚动 | 可以 | 可以 |
| 把页面图表导成 PNG | 可以，用页面自己的 canvas/SVG | 可以 |
| 截原生窗口 | 不行 | 可以 |
| 经得起 DSH 升级 | 可以 | 不行，每个版本都要重打补丁 |
| 对现有功能的风险 | 无 | 可能破坏侧边栏的链接处理 |

dsh-live-browser README · 工作原理：```
工具调用
      │  bridge.call(method, params)          lib/bridge.js
      ▼
   命令队列  ──────►  面板长轮询              client.js

dsh-live-browser README · 工作原理：- **`lib/bridge.js`** —— 队列与长轮询。冷调用会在队列里留够时间让客户端把标签页开出来；
  始终等不到面板的调用会带着可操作的提示失败，而不是一直挂着。
- **`lib/agent-script.js`** —— 注入每个 guest 文档的脚本。纯 DOM：带稳定 `ref` 的快照、
  点击、输入、按键、选择、悬停、滚动、读正文、执行表达式、等待、附加文件、canvas/SVG 转 PNG。
- **`lib/rpc.js`** —— 挂在 DSH web server 上的一个前缀路由（`/dsh-live-browser`），说面板那套
  简单的请求/响应信封。每个请求都校验同源与回环主机，因为这个路由既能写文件（`saveImage`）
  也能读文件（`readUpload`）。
- **`lib/config.js` / `lib/schema.js`** —— 配置值与 DSH 渲染的表单。取值部分不依赖第三方包，
  所以工具层和测试不需要 `node_modules` 就能跑。
- **`client.js`** —— 为每个存活的对话维护一个 worker：找到该对话侧边栏里的
  `webview[data-sidebar-browser-frame="webview"]`，注入脚本，需要时打开标签页，各自跑轮询。
  后台对话的侧边栏还挂在 DOM 里（`keepMounted`），它们的 worker 继续工作；同一栏里有多个
  标签时，挑真正有布局盒子的那个，而不是最后挂载的那个。标签页右键菜单也在这里补三项：
  监听 `contextmenu`，等 DSH 的菜单 portal 出现后追加按钮，仍然不改 DSH。整体包在 IIFE 里：
  DSH 会把多个插件 bundle 塞进同一个 combo `<script>`，顶层 `const` 会跟邻居撞名。

dsh-live-browser README · 为什么不用 `connection.rpc.handle`：在 dsh 0.2.1-rc.2 上，这个 API 用
`owner.effect(() => owner.webServer.register(route))` 建路由，而 `owner` 是 connection
插件自己的 context —— 它从没声明过 `webServer` 依赖。于是属性读取抛
`cannot get property "webServer" without inject`，effect 把错误吞掉，面板请求全部落到
静态前端兜底，表现为 **HTTP 405**。直接在 `webServer` 上注册是同一个调用，只是绕开了
那层坏掉的间接。

dsh-live-browser README · 工具：| 工具 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `browser_status` | 面板是否打开、当前是什么页面 |
| `browser_open_panel` | 打开侧边栏浏览器（也会自动发生） |
| `browser_navigate` / `back` / `forward` / `reload` | 导航 |
| `browser_snapshot` | 无障碍风格的节点列表，带稳定 `ref` |
| `browser_read_text` | 可见正文，可用选择器限定范围 |
| `browser_click` / `type` / `press` / `select` / `hover` | 页面交互 |
| `browser_scroll` / `wait` | 滚动与等待 |
| `browser_eval` | 在页面里执行一段 JS 表达式 |
| `browser_screenshot` | 把图表（canvas/SVG）或元素导出成 PNG |
| `browser_tabs` / `tab_new` | 列出标签页、新建标签页 |
| `browser_upload` | 给文件输入框附加本地文件 |
| `browser_downloads` | 列出下载目录里的文件 |
| `browser_confirm` | 请用户确认一个不可撤销的动作 |

dsh-live-browser README · 关于标签页：侧边栏把标签页 id 留在内部。插件操作的是获得焦点的那个 guest；没有焦点时，用当前对话的
右侧栏里真正显示着的那个标签页 —— 访问过的标签页都会保活挂在 DOM 里，按挂载顺序取最后一个
会点到看不见的页面。也没有 `tab` 参数去指别处 —— 这个参数以前存在却被静默丢弃，会让调用方
误以为自己指定了某个标签页。`browser_tabs` 仍然可以列出当前有哪些。

右键标签页的菜单里，插件补了三个动作：**关闭其他标签页**、**关闭全部标签页**、
**关闭右侧所有标签页**（当前标签右侧的全部，当前标签保留；没得关时置灰）。顺序取自当前
分栏的标签条，分栏两侧互不影响；菜单本体仍是 DSH 的，插件不接管它。浮动分栏没有标签条，
因此不提供这组动作。

dsh-live-browser README · 说实话的限制：有三件事 DSH 不开放给插件，插件以结构化结果如实报告，而不是假装成功：

- **`browser_tab_close` / `browser_tab_activate`** —— 侧边栏的标签 id 是内部的，工具会
  请你自己去点标签。
- **`browser_reset_profile`** —— 浏览器会话没有开放清理接口，工具返回操作步骤。
- **截原生窗口** —— guest 渲染在原生层，DOM 层面没有像素。`browser_screenshot` 改为让
  页面自己栅格化它的 `<canvas>`/`<svg>`，而这正是图表。

dsh-live-browser README · 安全：- 插件不改 DSH。它读官方侧边栏浏览器渲染出来的 DOM，往官方插件挂载的 guest 里注入脚本。
- `browser_eval` 会在当前加载的任何页面里执行任意 JavaScript。这是这个工具存在的意义，
  也是 `allowEval` 存在的原因。
- `confirmSensitive` 开着时，标记为 `sensitive` 的动作会先问用户；没有确认通道时是拒绝，
  不是放行。
- `/dsh-live-browser` 路由拒绝跨站与非回环的调用方。本机进程仍能伪造这些头，但它本来就能
  读写和你一样的文件。

dsh-live-browser README · 测试：```bash
node test/test-all.mjs
```

十三个套件，分两类：

- **不需要浏览器** —— 包完整性、工具契约、工具层、桥接、端到端链路、客户端驱动、
  会话绑定、标签菜单、设置项、DOM 行为。任何环境都能跑，`npm test` 即可。
- **需要真实页面** —— 场景、注入脚本、图表导出。它们通过 `test/fixtures/` 里的 CDP
  夹具驱动真实页面，这个夹具**只为测试而存在**；实际发的插件从不直接碰 Chrome。
  用 `node scripts/ensure-browser.mjs` 起一个，或者让它们报 `SKIP`。

「DOM 行为」和「端到端链路」原本也要真浏览器，现在改成在 jsdom 里跑同一份注入脚本，
所以不需要 Chrome。图表导出没跟着改，因为 jsdom 的 canvas 要额外装原生包 `canvas`，
为了跑测试把编译依赖架到使用者机器上不划算。

`test/test-rpc-http.mjs` 需要一个正在运行的 DSH：

dsh-live-browser README · 测试：```bash
node test/test-rpc-http.mjs "http://127.0.0.1:PORT/?token=..."
```

测试浏览器的路径可以用 `DSH_TEST_CDP_PORT`、`DSH_TEST_PROFILE_DIR`、
`DSH_TEST_DOWNLOAD_DIR` 覆盖。

> 本地改源码后，**必须重启 DSH**：宿主插件的工具注册只在进程启动时发生，文件变化
> 不会热生效。重启前 `browser_*` 工具和 `/dsh-live-browser` 路由都不存在（路由返回
> HTTP 405 就是没加载的信号）。

dsh-live-browser README · 文件不能带 BOM：`package.json` 这类文件如果开头混进 UTF-8 BOM，DSH 会报

```
installation rejected: Cannot validate installed package dsh-live-browser:
SyntaxError: Unexpected token ... is not valid JSON
```

然后把 `package.json`、`pnpm-lock.yaml` 和 `node_modules` **整体回滚**——插件装不上，
但代码本身毫无问题，现象是「工具和路由都不存在」，极难排查。

Windows 上用 PowerShell 的 `Set-Content`、`Out-File` 写文件很容易带上 BOM。仓库里带了
巡检脚本：

```bash
npm run strip-bom     # 扫掉全仓库文本文件的 BOM
```

dsh-live-browser README · 文件不能带 BOM：`test/test-package-integrity.mjs` 也会检查这一点，并核对 `files` 里声明的每个文件是否
真实存在、`exports` 指向的入口是否存在、运行时代码有没有 `console.log` 残留。

dsh-live-browser README · 在内置浏览器里实测：凡是依赖真实渲染的行为，都在 DSH 侧边栏的内置浏览器里跑过一遍。做法是先
`node scripts/verify-in-browser.mjs --serve` 起本地页面，再用 `browser_*` 工具驱动。

结论（实测通过）：

dsh-live-browser README · 在内置浏览器里实测：- **pointer 事件** —— 一次点击产生的序列是
  `pointerover, pointerenter, pointerdown, mousedown, pointerup, mouseup, click`，
  且每个事件恰好一次。只监听 `pointerdown` 的库（拖拽类、React 合成事件）也能收到。
- **编辑键** —— Backspace 删一个字符、Shift+A 输入大写 A（不是 `+A`）、
  Control+a 清空、Enter 在 textarea 里插入换行。
- **contenteditable** —— `browser_type` 能写入，编辑键也能作用在可编辑 div 上。
- **ref 生命周期** —— 连续多次 `browser_snapshot`，ref 数量稳定，不随快照次数增长。
- **链接跳转** —— 点击 `<a>` 会真实导航，落点页面的标题与正文都变了。

dsh-live-browser README · 在内置浏览器里实测：这几个行为里有三个曾经是真 bug：pointer 事件根本没派发、编辑键只发 keydown
不改值、修饰键被模板字符串的反斜杠吞掉导致 `Control+a` 解析成 `+a`。

dsh-live-browser README · dsh-live-browser：[](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/c347087870/dsh-live-browser)

Let the agent drive the browser DSH already ships — inside DSH, with nothing
leaving the window.

[中文](README.md) | English

DSH's own `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-browser` renders a real Electron
`<webview>` in the right sidebar, with an address bar, history and an independent
browser session. It exposes navigation only, so the agent can open a page but
cannot click, type, read or scroll it.

dsh-live-browser README · dsh-live-browser：This plugin closes that gap **without modifying DSH**: it finds the guests that
plugin mounted, injects a command surface into each document, and gives the model
25 `browser_*` tools that operate the page the human is looking at. It also fills
in the tab's right-click menu: **close other tabs / close all tabs / close tabs to
the right**.

dsh-live-browser README · Install：Requires DSH 0.2.x and Node.js 20 or newer. The plugin declares its DSH bundle in
`package.json`, so DSH registers it on install.
dsh-live-browser README · From GitHub：```bash

dsh-live-browser README · Web / CLI profile：dsh plugin --profile web add github:c347087870/dsh-live-browser
```

The desktop profile is owned by the Electron application, so install it from the
UI instead: **Plugins → Add plugin**, paste
`https://github.com/c347087870/dsh-live-browser`, then restart DSH.

dsh-live-browser README · From npm：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-live-browser
```

Package page: https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-live-browser . Installing from npm
is what makes the plugin show up in DSH's built-in plugin center.

node -e "const p=require('./node_modules/dsh-live-browser/package.json');console.log(p.version, p.dsh)"

`dsh.bundle.patch` must be present, and `lib/index.js` must exist. After a

dsh-live-browser README · Verify the install：> A junction (`mklink /J`, `ln -s`) does **not** work for local development: Node

dsh-live-browser README · Settings：DSH renders these on the plugin's settings card. Every one has a default, so the
plugin works without touching any of them.

dsh-live-browser README · Settings：| Setting | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `confirmSensitive` | `true` | Ask the user before an action marked `sensitive` |
| `allowEval` | `true` | Allow `browser_eval` to run arbitrary JavaScript in the page |
| `autoOpenPanel` | `true` | Open the sidebar browser when a command arrives with no page |
| `commandTimeoutMs` | `30000` | How long one command may wait for the panel |
| `openPanelWaitMs` | `8000` | How long to wait for a new panel to become ready |
| `maxSnapshotNodes` | `400` | Default node cap for `browser_snapshot` |
| `maxTextChars` | `12000` | Default character cap for `browser_read_text` |
| `waitTimeoutMs` | `10000` | Default timeout for `browser_wait` |
| `uploadMaxBytes` | `16777216` | Largest file `browser_upload` will hand to a page |
| `imageDir` | empty | Where `browser_screenshot` writes PNGs; empty uses `~/.dsh/storages/dsh-live-browser/images` |
| `downloadsDir` | empty | Directory `browser_downloads` lists; empty uses the system Downloads folder |

dsh-live-browser README · Settings：`allowEval: false` is the switch to reach for if you want the agent to read pages
without running code in them. `browser_eval` then returns `executed: false` and
points at `browser_snapshot` / `browser_read_text` instead.

dsh-live-browser README · Opening the browser：The agent never asks you to open a browser first, and it never reaches for an
external window:

- Tools queue a command on the host, tagged with the **conversation** that asked.
- The plugin's client bundle polls continuously, even when no browser tab exists.
- If a command arrives with no page on screen, the client opens the **DSH sidebar
  browser** itself (the same `openTabIn(sessionId, 'browser', …)` call the sidebar
  uses internally), waits for the guest to mount, then runs the command.

dsh-live-browser README · Opening the browser：So `browser_navigate` on a cold start shows up as a sidebar tab that opens by
itself and loads the requested page.

dsh-live-browser README · One browser worker per conversation：- Every live Session gets its own `panelId` and long poll, permanently bound to that
  Session id.
- Every command carries the Session id of the chat that issued it
  (`exec.agent.session.id` on the host). Background chats keep polling, so a command
  still runs in that chat's own webview even after the user switches away.
- A worker only looks inside its own Session's `[data-sidebar-right-session]`; it
  never touches the chat currently on screen. A background sidebar marked `hidden`
  does not stop execution.
- When the browser has to be opened, it opens in the **requesting** chat via
  `openTabIn(sessionId, …)`, not in whichever chat happens to be on screen.
- With several tabs in one Session, the one with a real layout box wins, not the
  last mounted one.
- A Web-build iframe is cross-origin to DSH and cannot be scripted:
  `browser_status` returns `mode: "iframe"` and the plugin shows a bottom-right
  notice pointing the user to the Desktop webview.

dsh-live-browser README · One browser worker per conversation：That stops the old failure mode: ask for a page in chat A, switch to chat B, and
have the command refused or the browser appear in B.

> Why the renderer does the opening: the sidebar lives entirely in the client —
> its host module contributes nothing — so there is no host service to call. The
> client half publishes `sidebarRight` through `ctx.reflect.provide`, which is
> what this plugin uses.

dsh-live-browser README · Why this shape：| | This plugin | Patching the shipped bundle |
|---|---|---|
| Click / type / read / scroll | yes | yes |
| Export a page's charts as PNG | yes, via the page's own canvas/SVG | yes |
| Native window screenshots | no | yes |
| Survives a DSH upgrade | yes | no — re-patch every release |
| Risk to existing features | none | can break sidebar link handling |

dsh-live-browser README · How it works：```
agent tool call
      │  bridge.call(method, params)          lib/bridge.js
      ▼
  command queue  ──────►  panel long-polls   client.js

dsh-live-browser README · How it works：- **`lib/bridge.js`** — the queue and the long poll. Cold calls stay queued long
  enough for the client to open a tab; a call that never gets a panel fails with
  an actionable message instead of hanging.
- **`lib/agent-script.js`** — the script injected into every guest document. Pure
  DOM: snapshot with stable `ref`s, click, type, press, select, hover, scroll,
  read text, evaluate, wait, attach files, capture canvas/SVG to PNG.
- **`lib/rpc.js`** — one prefix route on the DSH web server (`/dsh-live-browser`)
  speaking the panel's small request/response envelope. Every request is checked
  for a same-origin browser and loopback host, because the route can write files
  (`saveImage`) and read them (`readUpload`).
- **`lib/config.js` / `lib/schema.js`** — the settings values and the form DSH
  renders. Values are dependency-free so the tool layer and tests can read them
  without a `node_modules` tree.
- **`client.js`** — finds the guest inside **the current conversation's** sidebar
  (`webview[data-sidebar-browser-frame="webview"]`), injects the script, opens the
  tab when needed, and runs the poll loop. Background chats keep their sideba

dsh-live-browser README · Why not `connection.rpc.handle`：On dsh 0.2.1-rc.2 that API builds its route with
`owner.effect(() => owner.webServer.register(route))`, where `owner` is the
connection plugin's own context — which never declared a `webServer` dependency.
The property read throws `cannot get property "webServer" without inject`, the
effect swallows it, and every panel request falls through to the static frontend
fallback as **HTTP 405**. Registering on `webServer` directly is the same call
without the broken indirection.

dsh-live-browser README · Tools：| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `browser_status` | Is the panel open, what page is showing |
| `browser_open_panel` | Open the sidebar browser (also happens automatically) |
| `browser_navigate` / `back` / `forward` / `reload` | Navigation |
| `browser_snapshot` | Accessibility-style node list with stable `ref`s |
| `browser_read_text` | Visible body text, optionally scoped by selector |
| `browser_click` / `type` / `press` / `select` / `hover` | Page interaction |
| `browser_scroll` / `wait` | Scrolling and waiting |
| `browser_eval` | Run a JS expression in the page |
| `browser_screenshot` | Export a chart (canvas/SVG) or element as a PNG file |
| `browser_tabs` / `tab_new` | List tabs, open a new browser tab |
| `browser_upload` | Attach local files to a file input |
| `browser_downloads` | List files in the downloads folder |
| `browser_confirm` | Ask the human to confirm an irreversible action |

dsh-live-browser README · Tabs：The sidebar keeps its tab ids internal. The plugin acts on the focused guest, or
on the tab that is actually laid out in the current chat's sidebar when nothing
is focused: every visited tab stays mounted, so document order is not what the
human sees. There is no `tab` argument to aim it elsewhere: the parameter used to
exist and was silently dropped, which let a caller believe it had targeted a
specific tab. `browser_tabs` still lists what is open.

dsh-live-browser README · Tabs：The tab's right-click menu gains three entries: **close other tabs**, **close all
tabs**, and **close tabs to the right** (everything after this tab; the current
tab stays, and entries with nothing to close are disabled). Order comes from the
strip of the pane the menu was opened in, so split panes stay independent; the
menu itself still belongs to DSH. Floating panes have no strip, so they do not get
these entries.

dsh-live-browser README · Honest limits：Three things DSH does not let a plugin do, reported as structured results rather
than silent failures:

dsh-live-browser README · Honest limits：- **`browser_tab_close` / `browser_tab_activate`** — the sidebar keeps tab ids
  internal; the tool tells you to click the tab yourself.
- **`browser_reset_profile`** — the browser session is not exposed for clearing;
  the tool returns step-by-step instructions.
- **Native window screenshots** — the guest renders natively, so there are no
  pixels at the DOM level. `browser_screenshot` instead asks the page to
  rasterise its own `<canvas>`/`<svg>`, which is exactly what charts are.

dsh-live-browser README · Security：- The plugin never patches DSH. It reads the DOM the official sidebar browser
  renders and injects a script into guests the official plugin mounted.
- `browser_eval` runs arbitrary JavaScript in whatever page is loaded. That is the
  point of the tool and the reason `allowEval` exists.
- Actions marked `sensitive` ask the user first while `confirmSensitive` is on.
  A missing question channel denies rather than allows.
- The `/dsh-live-browser` route refuses cross-site and non-loopback callers. A
  local process could still spoof the headers, but it can already read and write
  the same files as you.

dsh-live-browser README · Tests：- **No browser needed** — package integrity, tool contracts, the tool layer, the
  bridge, the end-to-end path, the client driver, session binding, the tab menu,
  settings, DOM behaviour. These run anywhere.
- **Need a live page** — scenarios and chart capture. They drive a real page
  through the CDP harness in `test/fixtures/`, which exists **only** for testing;
  the shipped plugin never touches Chrome directly. Start one with
  `node scripts/ensure-browser.mjs`, or let them report `SKIP`.

dsh-live-browser README · Tests：`test/test-rpc-http.mjs` needs a running DSH:

```bash
node test/test-rpc-http.mjs "http://127.0.0.1:PORT/?token=..."
```

Paths for the test browser can be overridden with `DSH_TEST_CDP_PORT`,
`DSH_TEST_PROFILE_DIR` and `DSH_TEST_DOWNLOAD_DIR`.

dsh-live-browser README · Tests：> After editing the source locally, **DSH must be restarted**: host plugin tool
> registration happens only at process start, so file changes do not take effect.
> Until the restart, the `browser_*` tools and the `/dsh-live-browser` route do not
> exist (an HTTP 405 from that route is the signal that it is not loaded).

dsh-live-browser README · Publish：The plugin is installable straight from GitHub or npm with no registry step. To
have it listed in the community plugin markets that index GitHub, the repository
carries the `dsh-plugin` topic; those indexes rescan on their own schedule.
